CONVERSATION.NAME: Talk Stef down from her freakout.
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP:
Stefanie is freaking out in Pretty Vacant.
HUMILIATE: Make Stef realize how crazy she looks.
CALM: Defuse the situation and calm her down.

CARD.NAME: Biting words
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Say it with extra venom. Gives a bonus to all your humilating dialog.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of humilated,

CARD.NAME: Drink much?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Have you been drinking? I swear you smell you just stepped out of a keg.

CARD.NAME: Freak
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Do you always act like such a freak?

CARD.NAME: Offer some sympathy.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You've obviously had a really awful day, I'm sorry, but there's no reason to take it out on people you don't know.

CARD.NAME: Relax!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Take a deep breath.

CARD.NAME: Rumor: Stefanie is a Kleptomaniac.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I just got to this town and I already know you're a klepto, ever think the problem might be you?

CARD.NAME: Stop Screaming!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You know, I could hear you screaming all the way over in the park.

CARD.NAME: Stop, thief!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Look, it's clear you stole something. You should just give it back or this is going to get a lot worse for you.

CARD.NAME: Voice of reason
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Calm, cool, and collected, that's you. Unwind the situation, giving a bonus to all your dialog in play that increases calm.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of calm,

CARD.NAME: Where will you shop?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: This town's got a grand total of *one* clothing store, do you really want to be left wearing a canvas sack around town?

CARD.NAME: You'll end up in Jail.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Do you really want a police record at your age?

CARD.NAME: You're crazy.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Well it's nice to know I've already met the town lunatic.

CARD.NAME: You're making a scene!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Stop and think about what you're doing; people are literally running away from this place in fear.

CARD.NAME: You're making it worse
CARD.DESCRIPTION: The more you screech and flail around like an idiot, the worse you're making it for yourself.

CARD.NAME: You're overreacting
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Don't you think you're being a little melodramatic?

CARD.NAME: Blind rage
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Stefanie is on a huge rant, there's no calming her down. Makes all her dialog that reduces calm stronger.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all cards in play of calm,

CARD.NAME: Crying!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Stefanie starts crying and making pathetic little gasping sobs.

CARD.NAME: I can't take it anymore!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Please, can you just stop, okay? I can't take anymore! I'm seriously ready to throw myself in front of the next bus that passes by.

CARD.NAME: I don't care
CARD.DESCRIPTION: At this point, I really don't care what you random people think of me.

CARD.NAME: I have a right!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I have a right to be angry, how would you like it if you were accused of something you didn't do?

CARD.NAME: I'm losing it!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Look, I'm not normally like this. You wouldn't believe what's gone down today.

CARD.NAME: It's not me, it's this town.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: This town will drive anyone crazy. Trust me, you'll get there too.

CARD.NAME: The world is an awful place.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: What's wrong with people? Why are they so evil?

CARD.NAME: Who are you, anyway?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You don't even know me! Please, just leave me alone!

CARD.NAME: You'd be upset too.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You try having your heart broken and being called a thief on the same day. See how calm you are!
